videos.desc: When things go sideways: the five moments that test every facilitator, each a test of composure, judgment and skill, practised today in a safe place. Ends on the check-in about the rubrics and how facilitation feels now.

videos.title: Scenario 4: Someone Challenges You
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Role-Play Block — pause it on the freeze question.
videos.desc: The guide's Scenario 4 acted out in a circle: a man calls thinking errors a way to blame the men. It freezes on “What's your first instinct?”, then shows one way a peer facilitator could handle it, in the guide's coaching points.

videos.title: The Power of Silence
videos.when: Plays at the start of The Power of Silence.
videos.desc: The fear of silence, the four silences a facilitator can use, and ten seconds of real silence to count through. Ends on “Use the silence.”

videos.title: The Spirit of MI
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: What to do when the person you're trying to help doesn't want help: where MI came from, the one-sentence version (their reasons, not yours) and the week ahead. Ends on “Has anyone ever tried to change your mind by arguing with you?”

videos.title: The Four Principles of MI
videos.when: Plays at the start of The Four Principles of MI.
videos.desc: Partnership, acceptance, compassion and evocation, one at a time in the guide's words, with all four on screen. Ends on the check for understanding: MI or advice?

talks.title: Empathy is not endorsement
talks.speaker: Dylan Marron

videos.title: MI Skills for Mentors
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: From the why to the how: the rowboat, the four OARS skills one at a time, and why the hardest part is not giving advice. Ends on the rolling-with-resistance check-in.

videos.title: Reflections
videos.when: Plays at the start of OARS Skill 3: Reflections.
videos.desc: Simple and complex reflections side by side on the guide's two examples, and the three common mistakes. Ends on the triad practice.

videos.title: A Full OARS Conversation
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Integrated Practice — pause it on the question.
videos.desc: A mentee three weeks into FORGE says he's quitting. The video stops on the pairs' question, then shows a mentor using an open question, an affirmation, a reflection and a summary.

videos.title: MI in FORGE
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: Meeting someone where he is: the week so far, today's three situations, the readiness ruler, and MI as a practice, not a performance. Ends on the OARS homework check-in.

videos.title: The Readiness Ruler
videos.when: Plays at the start of The Readiness Ruler.
videos.desc: One question on a 1-to-10 scale, “What makes you a 4 and not a 1?”, the step up, and why a 4 is real. Ends on the two follow-ups.

videos.title: Scenario 3: MI During Conflict Resolution
videos.when: Plays in place of the live run of Scenario 3 in the Scenario Block — pause it on the question.
videos.desc: Ray and Deon's cold war over a dayroom seat. The video stops on “What's it really about?”, then shows a mentor using reflections, an open question and the readiness ruler with Ray.

talks.speaker: Megan Phelps-Roper

videos.title: Introduction to Simulations
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: Simulation training in the guide's words: FORGE makes you do it, the firefighter who practices, why it's uncomfortable, and why every mistake in a simulation is one you don't make in real life. Ends on the check-in question.

videos.title: How a Simulation Works
videos.when: Plays at the start of How Simulations Work.
videos.desc: The six steps lighting up one at a time with their minutes, the freeze questions to the mentor and the group, and feedback that is coaching, not a pile-on. Ends on the six steps.

videos.title: Freeze and Coach: A Demonstration
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Freeze and Coach demonstration — pause it when it freezes on the question.
videos.desc: The guide's demonstration scene acted out: a mentor walks up tense, the scene freezes on the group's question, one piece of coaching in the guide's words, and the calmer replay.
